scope:
Attribute a failed held-tool observation using retained frames and states.

This evaluator-only diagnostic reconstructs camera frames from recorded plant
states. Those calibration/segmentation values never enter a controller. It
tests appearance and search-window hypotheses, not online pose qualification.

proposal.scope:
Observe a partially occluded held tool from depth and own-robot geometry.

The known grasp bounds a search; it is never returned as a measurement. Remove
surfaces explained by the sensed robot pose, then fit the remaining visible
depth points to unposed tool CAD. A candidate is a partial surface observation,
not a qualified full pose, fingertip separation, or stable-grasp measurement.
proposal.source: Native depth, own-robot pose/visual meshes and unposed tool CAD

held_detector.calibration: Own-robot estimate from reconstructed encoders and IMU
